remote.description: Remote KB server URL, http(s) only (required when provider=http). Use https for any non-loopback host: plain http sends the token in cleartext.

token.description: Authentication token for remote KB server (stored encrypted, never logged)

token_command.description: Shell command that prints a bearer token on stdout, run to obtain and refresh the token (stored encrypted, never logged). Mutually exclusive with token. Example: my-token-cli print-access-token

token_ttl_seconds.description: Cache lifetime in seconds for a token_command token that is not a JWT with an exp claim (default 2700)

repo_path.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.
